about.title: About Me
about.p1: Driven by my own curiosity, I started diving into technology and coding – supported by a good friend who recognized and encouraged my passion. Solving problems through code feels like an endless puzzle to me – and that’s exactly what fascinates me. The ever-changing tech world keeps me curious and constantly challenged.
about.p2: Let’s connect and create something great together!
items: Based in Baden-Württemberg – I'm open to remote work, but not looking to relocate.
I'm always curious to explore new technologies and love pushing my skills to the next level.

When tackling problems, I usually start by experimenting and refining my approach. While I often work analytically on my own, I’m always open to collaborating with others when a challenge goes beyond my skill set. I believe in a mix of planning and hands-on problem solving to find the most effective solutions.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: I have gained valuable experience working on a variety of projects using modern front-end technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I’m always open to learning and adapting to new tools and frameworks. I believe that continuous learning is key to keeping up with the fast-paced world of web development.
skills.followup: I'm always eager to explore new technologies and frameworks to expand my capabilities.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.intro: Explore a selection of my work here. Interact with projects to see my skills in action

projects.join: A simple and intuitive task management app built with Angular and Firebase. It allows users to create, organize, and track their tasks efficiently, providing a seamless experience for staying productive.
projects.elpolloloco: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
projects.dabubble: A real-time chat application built with Angular and Firebase. It allows users to create accounts, join chat rooms, and exchange messages instantly, providing a seamless communication experience.

portfolio.reviewsTitle: What my colleagues say about me

reviews.text: Adrian is a reliable person with whom I very much enjoyed working on the project. Even in stressful situations, he keeps a cool head and is always ready to listen when things get stuck. Thank you for the pleasant collaboration!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.translationNote: This English text is a convenience translation. The German version is legally binding.
privacy.notice: This website is a purely private, non-commercial offering and is used exclusively for job applications. The protection of your personal data is important to me. Below I inform you in accordance with Art. 13 GDPR about which data is processed when you visit the website and when you get in touch.

sections.heading: 1. Controller
blocks: The controller responsible for data processing on this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:

Adrian Kleinschmidt
[Street and house number]
79114 Freiburg im Breisgau
Germany
Email: kontakt@akleinschmidt.net

sections.heading: 2. Overview: which data is processed?
blocks: Access data (server log files) when the website is called up,
Information you send me via the contact form or by email.

This website sets no cookies, integrates no analytics, tracking or advertising services and loads no fonts or scripts from third-party servers. There is no automated decision-making including profiling.
Your language selection is stored locally in your browser (local storage) so that it is remembered on your next visit. This information is not transmitted to me or to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Hosting and server log files
blocks: This website is hosted by ALL‑INKL.COM (Hauptstraße 68, 02742 Friedersdorf, Germany). When the website is called up, the server automatically collects data transmitted by your browser. In particular:
IP address,
date and time of the request,
page or file requested and amount of data transferred,
browser type and version, operating system,
referrer URL (previously visited page).

Processing is necessary to deliver the website and to ensure its stability and security. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure and error-free operation). The hosting provider stores the log data only as long as necessary for this purpose and deletes it afterwards. Where required, a data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR exists with the hosting provider.

sections.heading: 4. Contact form and contact by email
blocks: If you use the contact form, your name, email address and message are processed. The message is forwarded to me by email via the server of this website. No data is passed on to third parties. The same applies if you email me directly.

I use your information solely to process your enquiry and to get in touch with you, for example in connection with a job application. The legal bases are Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR, insofar as the enquiry serves to initiate a contractual relationship, and Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in answering enquiries). By ticking the checkbox in the form you confirm that you have taken note of the privacy policy and consent to the processing of your information (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR). You can withdraw this consent at any time with effect for the future.

Your information will be deleted as soon as your enquiry has been finally processed and no statutory retention obligations apply. Providing the data is voluntary; without it, however, I cannot answer your enquiry via the form.

sections.heading: 5. External links
blocks: This website contains links to external pages, for example to GitHub (source code) and to the live demonstrations of my projects. Only when you click a link is data (such as your IP address) transmitted to the respective provider. I have no influence on the data processing there. Please observe the privacy notices of the respective providers.

sections.heading: 6. Encryption
blocks: For security reasons, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognise an encrypted connection by “https://” in the address bar of your browser.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
blocks: You have the following rights against me as the controller with regard to your personal data:
Access (Art. 15 GDPR),
rectification (Art. 16 GDPR),
erasure (Art. 17 GDPR),
restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR),
data portability (Art. 20 GDPR),
objection to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR).
You can withdraw any consent given at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7 (3) GDPR). Simply contact kontakt@akleinschmidt.net.

sections.heading: 8. Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
blocks: Without prejudice to other remedies, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The competent authority is the supervisory authority of the federal state in which I reside: the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of Baden-Württemberg: Prof. Dr. Tobias Keber (Heilbronner Straße 35, 70191 Stuttgart, Germany). An overview of all authorities can be found on the website of the Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information.

sections.heading: 9. Currency of this policy
blocks: I will adapt this privacy policy if the website or the legal requirements change. The version published here applies.
